column1: # Lalivero interiors: the report to Faran and the search for Sheba.
# First account of the search and the fate of Idejima.

column3: I searched all night.\nI found nothing.{end_wait}
The surf is too high.\nOur boats can't get near.{end_wait}
I know every rock\nalong that coast.\nShe wasn't there.{end_wait}
Tolbi brought {actor_name:7}\nhere. We let them do it.\nWe must answer for that.{end_wait}
I'm sorry, Faran.\nWe should've done more.{end_wait}
{actor_name:7} isn't gone.\nWe haven't found her yet.{end_wait}
And what of {actor_name:6}\nand the others?{end_wait}
Nothing. Not yet.{end_wait}
Venus shook the coast.\nThe cliffs gave way.{end_wait}
Idejima broke away.\nThe ship was still there.{end_wait}
The whole peninsula\nwas swept out to sea?{end_now}
Then the lower passage\nmust be underwater.{end_wait}
Felix sent {actor_name:6}\ntoward the ship.{end_wait}
The current may have\ncarried them clear.{end_wait}
That's a lead.\nWe'll look for {actor_name:6}.{end_wait}
Isn't that right,\n{actor_name:1}?{end_now}

column1: # Faran's response, the Adept discussion, and the farewell.

column3: Thank you.\nPlease keep looking\nfor {actor_name:7}.{end_wait}
I understand.\nWe'll keep searching\nfor {actor_name:7}.{end_wait}
She's lived through\nthings I can't explain.\n{actor_name:7} won't give up.{end_wait}
But that fall...\nI couldn't even watch.{end_wait}
The sea rose to meet her.\nYou all saw it.{end_wait}
I want to believe\nit carried her safely.{end_wait}
A wave that high...\nIt might have saved her.{end_wait}
I won't call that chance.\nNot with Sheba.{end_wait}
I've served Babi for\nyears. This still\nfrightens me.{end_wait}
I know {actor_name:7}.\nShe wouldn't give up.{end_wait}
Sheba may be an Adept,\nlike the rest of us.{end_wait}
An Adept?\nIs that what {actor_name:7} is?{end_wait}
I've read that word\nin Babi's old records.{end_wait}
Could that power\nhave saved her?{end_wait}
Adepts can shape\nthe elements themselves.{end_wait}
You and your friends\nhave done what we\ncouldn't, {actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
You found a way\nthrough the ruins\nto Venus Lighthouse.{end_wait}
I followed {actor_name:7}.\nThe ruins stopped me.{end_wait}
You passed that barrier.\nCould {actor_name:7}\nhave crossed it?{end_wait}
They have Psynergy.\nWe don't, Faran.{end_wait}
{actor_name:2}, please.\nHe's worried for Sheba.{end_wait}
We're losing time.\nWe have to keep moving.{end_wait}
You're right.\nI won't hold you here.{end_wait}
Forgive me. I forgot\nyou have someone\nto find, too.{end_wait}
Every minute matters.\n{actor_name:6} may still live.{end_wait}
Then go.\nFind your friend.{end_wait}
The waters are rough.\nBe careful out there.{end_wait}
We will.\nSo should you.{end_wait}
I'll search every shore\nuntil I find her.{end_wait}
We'll find a way\nto look for {actor_name:7}.{end_wait}

column1: # Alternate report when the party did not see the ship at Idejima.

column3: We searched the shore.\nThere was no sign\nof any of them.{end_wait}
The shock from Venus\ntore the land apart.{end_wait}
Then Idejima itself\nwas swept out to sea...{end_wait}
Then {actor_name:6} and\nthe others...\nOh, no.{end_wait}
{actor_name:5} sent {actor_name:6}\ntoward the ship\nbefore we arrived.{end_wait}
We have no proof,\nbut they may have\nsurvived.{end_wait}
If they reached\nthe ship, they may\nbe out at sea.{end_wait}
We'll keep looking\nfor {actor_name:6}.{end_wait}
Isn't that right,\n{actor_name:1}?{end_now}
You'll find {actor_name:6}.\nI have to believe it.\nFarewell.{end_wait}
